parent: Frozen OKX V1.7 12H 2R target-expiry full-funded account
hypothesis: Separating long and short capital removes cross-direction competition for collateral and slots; compare the two balanced integer allocations of the original nine equal slots.
factor: Single factor: replace the shared nine-slot 1000U account with independent long and short cash-sharing accounts, testing 4 long/5 short and 5 long/4 short slots.

inputs.frozen_timeframe: OKX all-history through the frozen target-expiry account boundary

execution.native_paths: Use each original V1.7 2/3 2R target child only if its native fill is before the next 12H expiry; otherwise use the original full runner stop/EMA path for both child legs.
execution.capital_split: For n slots, initialize that direction with 1000*n/9 USDT, so a 4/5 allocation starts at 444.444.../555.555... USDT and a 5/4 allocation at 555.555.../444.444... USDT. No capital transfers.
execution.linear_wallet_adapter: Run each side with the existing VectorBT cash-sharing wallet at normalized 1000 USDT and that side's fixed slot count, then scale positions, fees, cash PnL, and synchronous hourly marks by n/9. This preserves the 1000/9 initial notional budget per original slot.
execution.fees: Original market exits and entries pay 5bp per fill; native 2R limit exits retain their 2bp maker fee. No extra slip in the primary account.

account.slot_priority: Existing low-prior-ATR entry_order from cloud_close_thirds.okx_paths() in each independent direction account.
